title: Booking status (bookings.status)
caption: CHECK list of tenant_<key>.bookings.status; transitions written by src/bookings (orchestrator, order-recorder, booking-sync, reconcile, cancellation) and src/console. Every transition writes a booking_events row in the same transaction. A ticketed booking must have ticketing_status issued; a failed one not_applicable (CHECK bookings_ticketing_ck).

states.label: pending
states.detail: Inserted by the claim (T1) with a new `reference` VX…; Flight Create Orders not answered yet. With `reconcile_until` set the reconciler is looking for the order (max 15 min); `reconcile_outcome = manual_review` hands it to staff.

states.label: confirmed
states.detail: Order exists (`amadeus_order_id`, `record_locator`), no tickets yet; `ticketing_status` pending/failed/manual_review drives issuance.

states.label: partially_ticketed
states.detail: Some travellers/segments ticketed; the ticketing job or staff issue the rest.

states.label: ticketed
states.detail: Every ticket issued (`booking_tickets` ISSUED); `ticketing_status = issued`, `issued_at` set.

states.label: cancelled
states.detail: `cancelled_at` required (CHECK); `cancelled_by` customer, staff, airline (sync) or system.

states.label: failed
states.detail: Amadeus refused (4xx), request never reached the order, re-price higher (`409 PRICE_CHANGED`), reconciliation found nothing, or staff closed a review as not booked. `failure_code` public, `failure_message` console only.

states.label: console.bookings.import
states.detail: A PNR imported in the console (`channel = import`): the status comes from the order (confirmed, partially_ticketed, ticketed, or cancelled when every segment is cancelled); no payment.

transitions.label: order created (record T2) / reconciler found it / review closed: order found
order created with tickets (issue=true, airline card)
4xx refusal, not sent, price changed, not found, review closed: not booked
Flight Order Issue (checkout, ticketing job, staff issue, sync)
release (DELETE) by customer, staff or airline (sync)
void the same day / airline cancelled, recorded by resync
